Investigations
1- Chest X-ray:
-Cardiomegaly with RVH & RAD.
' - Plethoric lungs.
2- ECG:
- RVH & RAD.
- Right bundle branch block is common.
3- Echo: diagnostic
4- Cardiac catheter: pre operative.
ECG: sinus tachycardia (commonest), S1Q3T3, right bundle branch block, T-wave inversion V1–V4 (right heart strain).
